pageProps.title: Mindfulness Murder
pageProps.review: Karsten Dusse's novel Mindfulness Murder, which features a unique setting of coolly overcoming a murder crisis through meditation, is an interesting crime thriller work that feels like a US drama with its fast pace and visual beauty.
pageProps.description: I didn't commit my first murder until I was 42. I am a lawyer and I killed my client.
pageProps.content:
## Review When I first encountered the title, I thought it was about murdering someone remotely through meditation. It was ```Mindfulness Murder```, where one commits a murder and then coolly overcomes the crisis through meditation. Of course, it might have been because of meditation that the case started.
The last scene seems like a scene that leaves room for the next season.
From the beginning, it felt like a novel made with visualization in mind. It definitely feels like a US drama, and it seems like a subject matter that would be interesting even if visualized.
